name: Aral Sea (North / Small Aral)
cadence_note: every 2th year (plus 2025) to fit the time budget; not interpolated
why_selected: Part of the Aral Sea separated by a dam (Kokaral, 2005); partial recovery afterwards. Data-only description.
mndwi_note: Boundary with the South Aral at 46.1 N is approximate (the sea was one water body until about 1987); every 2nd year.

lake_polygon.method: largest connected MNDWI>0 component (pixel water in >=50% of valid years) containing the seed, +1 km buffer
lake_polygon.seed_fallback: seed not on water (seed is 68 px from the nearest water); largest water component of the box used

basin.fallback_reason: ValueError: no basin intersects the lake polygon

masks_encoding: PNG uint8: 0 no data, 90 land, 255 water; grid.json has crs/affine/shape
